crossRefs.note: Behold, when we come into the land, tie this line of scarlet thread in the window which you used to let us down. Gather…
So Michal let David down through the window. He went away, fled, and escaped.

translations.web: I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall, and escaped his hands.
translations.bsb: But I was lowered in a basket through a window in the wall and escaped his grasp.
translations.kjv: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.
translations.asv: and through a window was I let down in a basket by the wall, and escaped his hands.
